forms.mobility: Swept split shoulder/hip/calf panels, compact round thrusters and small temple fins; free joints and same body.
forms.opened: General-form amphitheater arches, sunlight, face, palms, crossed leg stance and boot endpoints preserved; white-gold gaps reveal hinge structures without weapons.
